mentions.name: Chalk
mentions.description: Chalk is an AI system design interviewer that provides structured, time-limited practice interviews. It is built for training for system design interviews and self-learning, reflecting the author's view that system design is more important than ever in the AI era.
mentions.problem: System design is more important than ever in the AI era, and there was a lack of structured, time-limited practice for system design interviews and self learning.
mentions.audience: In this AI era, I think system design is more important than ever. Thinking about how much I learned in interviews, I created Chalk to train for system design interviews and self learning.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on Chalk (https://chalkinterview.com/)

It is a AI system design interviewer, structured and time limited.
